name: Slaughterhouse Machinery Trap (CR 7)
body:
Slaughterhouse Machinery Trap
CR 7 (XP 3,200)

STATISTICS

Type mechanical; Notice Perception DC 25; Remove Disable Device DC 20; Trigger location; Reset automatic; Bypass hidden switch (Perception DC 30 to locate)

EFFECTS

Attack +10 melee (3d6+6); multiple targets (each target approaching within 5 feet of the machinery)
